data.name: Gunslinger
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses gunslinger as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses gunslinger as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Firearm Proficiency: At 3rd level, she gains proficiency in all firearms.
&nl;Gunsmith: At 7th level, she gains the gunsmith class feature.
&nl;Deed: At 11th level, she gains the Amateur Gunslinger feat.
&nl;Improved Deed: At 15th level, she gains a 3rd-level gunslinger deed of her choice.
&nl;Greater Deed: At 19th level, she gains a 7th-level gunslinger deed of her choice.
